prior_findings.title: Mandatory go-unit check failed due to intentional test failure
prior_findings.scenario: Running `go test ./...` after merging this PR causes the suite to fail because `TestReviewAgentRecoveryCanary` calls `t.Fatal("intentional Review Agent recovery canary failure")` at line 8.
prior_findings.impact: The `go-unit` mandatory check exits with code 1, blocking merge eligibility. The sealed baseline evidence from the first ledger result records this failure.
evidence: PR body: "This is an intentionally failing, temporary Review Agent canary"
PR body: "Do not merge this pull request."
patch content: t.Fatal("intentional Review Agent recovery canary failure")
prior_findings.resolution: Remove or modify `TestReviewAgentRecoveryCanary` so it does not call `t.Fatal`, or close this canary PR without merging as documented in the PR body.
